title: Device button for mobile, tablet, desktop
summary: The header has a new Device button at the left of Docs. Its menu has Mobile (390 px), Tablet (820 px) and Desktop (the full page). When you pick Mobile or Tablet, all the views show at that width in the middle of the page, with the layout of that width. The tests pass and the commit is dcf42ea.
actions: Put the id of a scheduled task into Notes Settings, New session task, to use Send now new session.

run.words: add button on a header device that show to select mobile tablet desktop and we need show all views base on that
